solutions.title: DFS + memo on remaining needs
solutions.notes: Try each offer or buy leftovers at list price
solutions.description:
**Approach:** Recurse on the leftover needs tuple; cache the best price for each leftover.

**Example walkthrough:** Needs `[3,2]`. Trying special `[1,2,10]` leaves needs `[2,0]`; pay `2·2 = 4` more for total `14`. Other mixes cost more; memo remembers each leftover needs tuple.
